DAILY ROUTINE

Switch. Wash. Hang. Done.

POST ONE stays mounted and hydraulically connected in normal use. Your daily water-routing action is simply SHOWER ↔ POST.

1◫
LOADPlace one sports outfit inside.
2↔
SNAPSwitch water routing to POST.
3⌁
RINSEBrief pre-rinse through the load.
4◌
DOSEAdd a small detergent dose.
5↻
WASHReversible manual tumble.
6⇣
DRAIN + RINSEDrain, then rinse clean.
7◎
SPINSelect SPIN and crank faster.
8⌇
HANG + RESETDeploy POST LINE; return to SHOWER.

DESIGN PRINCIPLES

Less friction after training.

● ● ●

Always ready

POST SNAP and the dedicated hose remain connected, so the daily routine begins with a switch — not a plumbing task.

● ● ●

One-outfit focus

The product is deliberately designed around the gear from one workout instead of trying to replace a household washer.

● ● ●

Mechanical intelligence

No electric pump, screen or software. Water comes from the shower; wash and spin are powered manually.
